messages:
sara-partnerships: Heads-up 10: customer PO 87654321 is stuck in the AWS Marketplace because the billing entity on the PO (Redwood EMEA Ltd) doesn't match the vendor tax registration on the listing. Portal error: TAX_ENTITY_MISMATCH.

leah-partners: Customer is APAC-based but requesting EMEA billing entity to use existing contract. They emailed procurement a signed PO this morning. We need a quick unblock or they'll revert.

finance-raj: What's the exact portal rejection payload? We need to know whether it's VAT ID mismatch or country/jurisdiction.

leah-partners: From customer screenshot:

```
{
  "errorCode": "TAX_ENTITY_MISMATCH",
  "message": "Billing entity country (GB) does not match vendor tax registration (IE)",
  "details": {"billingEntity": "Redwood EMEA Ltd (GB)", "vendorTaxCountry": "IE"}
}
```

ace-legal: If vendor listing is registered in Ireland (IE) but PO shows UK entity, that's a tax/legal exposure for both sides. We can't just change the PO without an amendment or explicit vendor acceptance.

vendor-lucy: We recently updated our marketplace listing to use our IsleTax entity (IE) for VAT reporting. We can add Redwood EMEA Ltd as an alternative billing entity, but that requires marketplace vendor portal change and a DUNS verification step. I can raise with vendor support.

marketplace-bot: Listing-change request queued (requestId: LCR-99877). ETA for vendor-side review: 48-72 hrs.

procure-annie: Customer deadline is EOD Wednesday. If marketplace-side change takes 48+ hrs we need a manual workaround: can we accept the PO offline and invoice directly? CFO needs approval.

mike-salesops: Offline invoice is possible but breaks marketplace billing reconciliation and might affect reserved capacity mapping. Also procurement prefers marketplace flow for entitlement provisioning.

finance-raj: Finance can approve an offline invoice as an exception if legal signs off and we get vendor confirmation in writing. We'll need to track in our ledger with a manual reconciliation tag.

ace-legal: I can draft a short addendum allowing Redwood to accept the PO under EMEA billing with vendor written confirmation that tax reporting will be handled by vendor IE entity. That addendum needs vendor sign-off. ETA 6 hrs.

vendor-lucy: We can sign the addendum. Also opening support ticket with Marketplace to add alternate billing entity on the listing (via LCR-99877). Will post updates.

leah-partners: Action items: 1) Ace to draft addendum (ETA 6 hrs); 2) Vendor to confirm in writing and file LCR-99877; 3) Finance to approve offline invoice exception once addendum + vendor note present; 4) Ops to mark PO as "manual-fulfilled" to provision entitlement.

procure-annie: I'll pause payment until docs are in place; will accept the manual provisioning but need audit trail.

marketplace-bot: Compliance check: marketplace-feed-sync reported mismatch in tax_entity mapping for listing AH-MARKET-01 on 2025-01-04T09:22:15Z. See logs: /var/log/mfeed/taxmap-20250104.log

mike-salesops: I'll notify the customer with this text: "We're processing an exception to accept your PO while we update marketplace billing metadata; you'll receive an invoice and entitlement within 24 hrs. We'll follow up with formal addendum." Sending now.

leah-partners: Customer replied: "Thanks, please proceed. We need access for a pilot tomorrow."

ace-legal: Addendum drafted and uploaded to folder: https://redwood.share/legal/addenda/PO-87654321-addendum.pdf. Vendor sign-off pending.

vendor-lucy: Signed addendum attached in vendor portal and emailed to @leah-partners. Also escalated LCR-99877 to vendor support rep Tom.

finance-raj: Received vendor note and addendum. Approving exception. Tagging ledger entry: MANUAL-MP-87654321. Will reconcile when marketplace listing updated.

marketplace-bot: Entitlement provisioning request created for PO 87654321 by ops-user ellie-ops. Status: pending-manual-fulfillment.

leah-partners: Thanks everyone. Closing in on unblock. Please keep the thread updated when LCR-99877 moves to "applied" so we can retire the manual ledger tag.

sara-partnerships: Summary & owners: Ace (legal) 10 draft addendum (done) / vendor sign-off. Vendor-lucy: escalate LCR-99877 (in progress). Finance-raj: approve offline invoice (done). Procure-annie: hold payment until docs (paused). Ops (ellie-ops): provision entitlement manual (pending). Mike: customer comms. Monitoring until marketplace applied.

All: react with :white_check_mark: when you acknowledge.
